mapper.sql: id, session_id, token_hash, token_type, generation, context_version, parent_token_id, replaced_by_token_id, expires_at, consumed_at, revoked_at, created_at, version
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO vi_session_token (session_id, token_hash, token_type, generation, context_version, parent_token_id, replaced_by_token_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{tokenHash}, #{tokenType}, #{generation}, #{contextVersion}, #{parentTokenId}, #{replacedByTokenId}, #{expiresAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM vi_session_token WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND token_type = #{tokenType}
SELECT FROM vi_session_token WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE vi_session_token SET consumed_at = #{consumedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, replaced_by_token_id = #{replacedByTokenId}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL

UPDATE vi_session_token SET revoked_at = #{revokedAt,typeHandler=com.xinyi.rongli.platform.mybatis.ViUtcInstantTypeHandler}, version = version + 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
